# Shakedown Spins

Shakedown Spins is a web-based record collection randomizer for vinyl collectors.

Primary URL: https://shakedownspins.joekirchner.com/welcome
Application URL: https://shakedownspins.joekirchner.com/
GitHub: https://github.com/pelle989/Shakedown-Spins
Contact: https://joekirchner.com/#contact

## What It Does

- Connects to a signed-in user's Discogs collection through OAuth or a personal token.
- Imports CSV record collections, including common Discogs export headers.
- Randomizes albums from Street Feed, My Stash, or Friends Stash.
- Filters albums by genre and decade.
- Lets users share stashes with friends and compare matching albums.
- Supports adding the web app to iOS and Android home screens.

## Privacy Notes

- Private stashes require sign-in and stay private unless shared.
- Public CSV uploads go to Street Feed.
- Signed-in sessions can stay active for about 360 days without reauth unless the user signs out, clears cookies, or the session is removed.

## Data Sources

Album notes, facts, and artwork may use Wikipedia, TheAudioDB, Discogs, MusicBrainz / Cover Art Archive, and iTunes. Third-party content belongs to its respective owners.
